prompts.phone:

Match the mascot's body, eyes, two purple leaves plus mint leaf, small limbs, reading book. Do not invent mascots or letters. Use the existing logo visually, no halo/glow surrounding logo.
Design intent: warm premium family companion with clear priorities for a parent, NOT corporate analytics dashboard or a repetitive stack of identical cards. Strong alignment, generous touch targets, 20 px screen margins, coherent vertical rhythm. Avoid gold, serif type, fake luxury black, glass, huge empty boxes, tiny text.

Status bar 9:41. Small full gina logo top left. Top right pill with lock icon and 'Çocuk modu', then circular notification bell.
Compact unboxed greeting hero: left 'Merhaba, Deniz' large bold on two lines if needed, below '2 Kasım Pazartesi'; a distinct mint plush reading mascot at right around 125 logical px tall, subtle lavender shape behind it, integrated naturally, no enormous scene. No slogan.

The prominent first interactive area is a light warm peach rounded approval surface, heading 'Onayını bekliyor' and badge '1'. One task row with book icon, '20 dakika kitap oku' and 'Ece · 3 yıldız'. Two fully readable large buttons: quiet lilac 'Geri gönder' and dominant satin purple 'Onayla'. Do not approve en masse, no tiny icon-only review action.
Below, an unboxed section heading 'Günün planı' with clear 'Takvimi aç' link. A cohesive compact timeline with 2 upcoming rows, not separate floating panels: '09:00' 'Matematik' 'Ece · Ders'; '16:00' 'Yüzme' 'Can · Etkinlik'. Pastel subject icons and slender connecting vertical line, no made-up chart.
Below, compact section 'Çocukların ilerlemesi', two parallel compact child summaries with portrait, 'Ece' '2 / 3 görev' '18 yıldız' and 'Can' '1 / 4 görev' '12 yıldız'. Mint slim progress bars. NO ranking/comparison winner.
Visible row of quick shortcuts, integrated soft-lavender segmented surface: '+ Görev' 'Prova' 'Ödül'. All labels legible, 48 px touch height.
Bottom anchored navigation spread evenly full width 'Bugün' selected purple, 'Takvim', 'Prova', 'Diğer', full icon+label and safe area. Content is allowed to continue on scrolling; do not squeeze unseen goals into first viewport.
